definitions: To return something to its proper place after use.
To save money for future use.
To eat or drink a large amount of something.
To send someone to prison or a mental institution.
To kill an animal, especially a pet, because it is old, ill, or dangerous.
examples: Please put away your toys when you're finished playing.
She tries to put away a little money each month for a rainy day.
He can really put away a lot of food when he's hungry.
The judge decided to put him away for ten years.
It was sad, but we had to put the old dog away last week.
